notes:
{思|おも}い{出|で} refers to memories, often with emotional or nostalgic connotations.

WORD FORMATION:
{思|おも}い (thought) + {出|で} (coming out) - memories that 'come out' when recalled

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {思|おも}い{出|で}になる: to become a memory
- {思|おも}い{出|で}に{残|のこ}る: to remain in one's memory
- {思|おも}い{出|で}を{作|つく}る: to make memories
- {思|おも}い{出|で}がよみがえる: memories come flooding back
- いい{思|おも}い{出|で}: good/fond memories

RELATED VERB:
{思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to remember, recall ({出|で/だ} reading varies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {記憶|きおく}: memory (more neutral/scientific)
- {追憶|ついおく}: reminiscence (literary)
